_comment: 🔮️ Structural Analysis View's own contribution to the repository test platform: `ruststep` 0.4 registered as the independent ISO 10303-21 reader for this subset's `Ifc2x3SavMutation` vocabulary, and the mutation catalog it is measured against. The vocabulary is NOT the ✳️any subset's -- every kind below is one rule of the conformance gate this repository already implements in production (`../🧬️schema/🦀️component.rs`'s `check_sav_conformance`). The `semantic-ifc-v1` comparison profile is the ✳️any subset's own contribution, reused rather than copied.

oracles.rationale:
🩹️ RECLASSIFIED (ticket SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION, shard A10, 2026-09-02). This entry was registered `third-party-library` on the strength of a real crate that does genuine codec work, but the mutation's expected RESULT is computed by this owner's own `🦀️oracle.rs` -- its dispatch function's catch-all arm is `"mutation kind {...} has no oracle implementation"`, proof that every OTHER arm is an implementation, not a reading. Both halves of the comparison then descend from the same specification, so a shared misreading produces two agreeing wrong answers -- the one failure a differential oracle exists to catch. This is a `cross-semio-implementation`: a required SUPPLEMENT (metamorphic/inverse/round-trip evidence), never a substitute. A qualifying third-party reference for the mutation semantics is still owed. See $TICKET/📓️a10-oracle-honesty.md.

IFC2X3 is physically ISO 10303-21 syntax under the IFC2X3 EXPRESS schema, and `ruststep` 0.4 parses it exactly as it parses STEP AP214 -- already linked and already registered for the sibling `ifc 2x3/✳️any` and `step ap214/✳️any` subsets, re-confirmed here against this subset's own committed input. It has NO writer at all, which per the fleet brief's §6 rules out `@mode-differential`: it cannot be a second PRODUCER of mutated bytes. It is registered strictly as the INDEPENDENT READER -- every mutation this subset's dispatcher performs (ruststep parse plus the standard-level from-scratch Part-21 writer at `../../../🦀️oracle.rs`, never this repository's own production `step::engine::part21` writer) is read back through a FRESH `ruststep::ast::Exchange::from_str` call before `semantic-ifc-v1` compares it. FIXTURE CAVEAT, recorded rather than hidden: this repository contains NO real IFC2X3 StructuralAnalysisView document -- grepping the FULL 21 MB real source for `IFCSTRUCTURAL*` returns zero matches -- so the committed input `🧫️fixtures/🏗️wellness-center-sama-structural-seed.ifc` is the real 3464-entity export with its view definition re-stamped and exactly three seeded structural entities appended (derivation script: `.🧬semio/🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️23/END-TO-END-TESTING-REFACTOR/ifc-2x3-mvd-subsets/🐍️derive-structural-seed.py`, both files committed and auditable). STRONGER REFERENCE EVALUATED AND NOT ADOPTED: `ifcopenshell` 0.8.4 (Python) reads AND writes IFC and would make a genuine `@mode-differential` possible; it installed and imported successfully here and the Python oracle host has landed (precedent: `🗿️artifacts/📄️pdf/🧪️tests/extract-text-pdf-1-4/🐍️component.py`). It was NOT adopted because putting a Python distribution on a generated host's import path requires an `oracleHostPackages` entry in the SHARED `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🔣️oracle.json`, which this wave's brief forbids an executor from editing.
